definitions.explanation: A past court decision, especially of a higher court, that serves as an example or authority for deciding later cases with similar facts. Collectively, the body of such decisions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{過去|かこ}→過去：00152_kako⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{判例|はんれい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{参考|さんこう}→参考：02828_sankou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧{判例|はんれい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: There is no precedent that serves as a reference for this case.

examples.japanese: {最高裁|さいこうさい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{判例|はんれい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦その{後|ご}→その後：08501_sonogo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{下級審|かきゅうしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}を{与|あた}える→影響を与える：26072_eikyouwoataeru⟧。
examples.english: Supreme Court precedents have a great influence on the decisions of lower courts thereafter.

notes:
Composed of {判|はん} (judgment) + ⟦{例|れい}→例：09932_rei⟧ (example). Refers to prior court decisions used as a guide for later cases; Supreme Court ({最高裁|さいこうさい}) precedents carry particular weight.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {判例|はんれい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従|したが}う→従う：02059_shitagau⟧: to follow precedent
- {判例|はんれい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}する→変更する：30779_henkousuru⟧: to overturn / change a precedent
- {判例|はんれい}{集|しゅう}: a collection of precedents; a casebook

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{前例|ぜんれい}→前例：11790_zenrei⟧: a precedent — the everyday word for any prior example, not limited to court decisions
- ⟦{判決|はんけつ}→判決：05906_hanketsu⟧: a (court) judgment — a single ruling; {判例|はんれい} is a judgment treated as an authority for later cases
